title: SoftServe: A Scalable Quasi-Newton Method for Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.02182v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quasi-Newton (QN) methods have long been among the most effective methods for large-scale unconstrained convex optimization. Two obstacles have limited their use in deep learning: non-convexity and enormous parameter sizes. We introduce SoftServe, a family of QN methods designed to overcome these obstacles without line searches or ad hoc curvature corrections. SoftServe derives positivedefinite curvature estimates from the variational objective of Berglund et al. (2025), even in the presence of negative curvature. We develop diagonal and Kroneckerfactored variants that preserve positive definiteness by construction and scale to massive neural networks. Finally, SoftServe relies on the stable coupled Newton-Schulz iteration for the required matrix operations, replacing costly matrix decompositions with GPU-friendly matrix multiplications. SoftServe excels on problems that are severely ill-conditioned, including tasks such as recurrent n

translated_title: SoftServe：一种面向深度学习的可扩展拟牛顿方法
translated_abstract: 拟牛顿（QN）方法长期以来一直是大尺度无约束凸优化中最有效的方法之一。有两个障碍限制了它们在深度学习中的应用：非凸性和巨大的参数规模。我们提出了SoftServe，这是一族旨在克服这些障碍的拟牛顿方法，且无需线搜索或临时的曲率修正。SoftServe从Berglund等人（2025）的变分目标中推导出正定的曲率估计，即使在存在负曲率的情况下也能如此。我们开发了对角形式和Kronecker分解形式的变体，它们在构造上即可保持正定性，并能扩展到大规模神经网络。最后，SoftServe依靠稳定的耦合Newton-Schulz迭代来完成所需的矩阵运算，用对GPU友好的矩阵乘法取代了代价高昂的矩阵分解。SoftServe在严重病态的问题上表现卓越，包括诸如循环神经网络等任务（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出SoftServe——一族无需线搜索、即使在负曲率存在时也能从变分目标获得正定曲率估计、借助对角与Kronecker分解变体以及GPU友好的稳定Newton-Schulz迭代、可扩展至大规模神经网络的拟牛顿方法，突破了拟牛顿方法在深度学习中应用的非凸性与参数规模两大障碍。
